description: This is a React Native screen component for editing or creating notes in a note-taking app. It handles input fields for title, content, and category, with options to save or delete a note. It interacts with a context for notes management and navigates between screens.

methods.name: NoteEditorScreen
methods.description: Main React functional component for the note editor screen, managing note state and user interactions.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the current note via updateNote, with guard for missing id.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deleting the note, prompting user confirmation.
